name: requirements-to-code
description: Use for converting business requirements, user stories, screenshots, or process descriptions into implementation tasks, data models, APIs, validations, and acceptance criteria.
---

# Requirements to Code

Translate business language into technical work.

Produce:
- Actors/roles.
- Core entities.
- Business rules.
- Validation rules.
- State transitions.
- Required screens/endpoints.
- Data model changes.
- Authorization rules.
- Notifications/integrations.
- Acceptance criteria.
- Edge cases.

Identify contradictions or missing rules and infer from existing system behavior where possible.
